walk.title: 걷기
keys: 00 contact A: the NEAR lighter leg A reaches forward screen-right, heel down; FAR darker leg B extends behind, toe pushing. Moderate stride. Upper body and rifle steady.
02 passing A: near A supports under the pelvis, far B knee and boot pass behind/under the near leg toward screen-right, boot lifted only 10-14 pixels. Legs clearly cross.
04 contact B: FAR darker B now forward screen-right heel down, NEAR lighter A back on its toe. REVERSE the support roles of 00; do not mirror the whole character.
06 passing B: far B supports under pelvis, near A knee/boot passes in front/under body toward screen-right with small toe lift. Opposite support leg to 02.
between: 01 halfway from key 00 to 02: A accepts weight under a soft knee, B pushes off behind and begins crossing under the body.
03 halfway from key 02 to 04: B extends forward preparing heel contact, A heel lifts behind.
05 halfway from key 04 to 06: B accepts weight, A pushes off behind and crosses under the body.
07 halfway from key 06 back to 00: A extends forward preparing heel contact while B heel lifts. Natural loop into 00, no neutral standing pause.

walk_fire.title: 걸으며쏴
keys: 00 near A forward contact / shot-release pose: same gait phase as walk key 00, M16 stock firmly at shoulder, slight recoil into shoulder; NO muzzle flash.
02 near A support / far B crossing passing: same phase as walk key 02, torso recovering from recoil without changing body size; both grips fixed.
04 far B forward contact / next shot-release: opposite support roles, same phase as walk key 04, slight shoulder recoil; NO muzzle flash.
06 far B support / near A crossing passing: same phase as walk key 06, recover shoulder and rifle to forward aim.
between: 01 A weight acceptance / B toe-off, peak modest shoulder-back recoil, head and cape lag slightly; same leg placement as walk frame 01.
03 B extending forward / A back, recoil settled to aimed walk; match walk frame 03.
05 B weight acceptance / A toe-off, peak modest shoulder recoil; match walk frame 05.
07 A extending forward / B back, recoil settled to aimed walk; match walk frame 07, flowing into 00.

idle.title: 정지
keys: 00 normal quiet aimed standing/guard pose, match the provided exact baseline stance, knees soft and feet planted.
02 inhale: a subtle 1-2 pixel chest/shoulder expansion upward, head follows by 1 pixel, hands and rifle remain shouldered; feet do not move.
04 breath apex: same proportions, tiny chest lift and delayed slight movement at hair/cape tips only.
06 exhale: shoulders/chest settle toward baseline, slight late cloth tip movement; both boots remain exactly planted.
between: 01 halfway inhale from 00 to 02, very small breathing motion, no foot movement.
03 halfway from inhale 02 to apex 04, upper body settles at top of breath, no body scaling.
05 halfway exhale from 04 to 06, hair/cape tip lags gently.
07 almost back to baseline 00, seamless quiet breathing loop; no head turn or blink needed.

idle_fire.title: 서서쏴
keys: 00 first shot-release shoulder pose, same standing feet/pelvis as baseline and idle; M16 shouldered, NO flash.
02 recoil settlement: shoulder/chest return forward after first shot, fingers remain on the same grips, no foot translation.
04 next shot-release shoulder pose, same planted stance, small upper-body compression back; NO flash.
06 second recoil settlement: same body scale and aim, slight delayed hair/cape movement.
between: 01 peak first recoil: shoulder/chest move back only 2-3 pixels; neck/head follows slightly, stock stays touching shoulder.
03 full aimed recovery before next shot, head stable, cape/hair still catching up.
05 peak second recoil, matching the same two grips and planted feet.
07 full aimed recovery, flowing back into 00. No muzzle flash, smoke, cartridge or separate FX.

kneel.title: 앉기
keys: 00 START STANDING: exact baseline aimed guard stance, same height, both hands on M16.
02 lowering: bend both knees and hips, pelvis halfway down, front boot toward screen-right stays planted; rear leg begins folding backward under body.

04 near-kneeling: rear knee approaches ground in front of/below pelvis, front knee raised over the forward flat boot, torso/stock/eyes still aligned toward screen-right. Body height naturally lower; DO NOT enlarge head/torso/rifle.

06 settled one-knee aim: adopt the supporting pose reference's low kneeling structure in the baseline's shallow 12-degree view. Rear knee on ground, front boot planted farther screen-right, front shin roughly upright, M16 horizontal, cape excess drapes on ground behind. No requirement for support elbow to touch knee.
between: 01 between standing 00 and lowering 02: hips drop, knees soften, rear heel starts lifting while front foot supports.
03 between lowering 02 and near-kneel 04: rear knee descends toward floor, front boot stays planted, head/torso travel downward together without scaling.
05 between near-kneel 04 and settled 06: rear knee makes soft ground contact, cape trailing length folds onto ground behind.
07 END HOLD: fully settle into the same kneeling aim as key 06 with a tiny final weight shift. This is the final held state, not a loop back to standing.

kneel_fire.title: 앉아쏴
keys: 00 first kneeling shot-release: copy the supplied approved kneeling key pose at the same low screen position and scale, both hands hold M16, no flash.
02 kneeling recoil settlement: shoulder/chest settle forward into stock without moving grounded knee or front boot.
04 next kneeling shot-release: small shoulder-back compression, front boot and rear knee fixed, no flash.
06 kneeling recoil settlement: head/shoulder recover, cape/hair have slight delayed response, same low seated scale.
between: 01 peak first kneeling recoil: chest/shoulder move back 2-3 pixels, head follows softly; front foot and rear knee absolutely anchored.
03 recovered kneeling aim: rifle horizontal, stock contact and two hand grips retained.
05 peak second kneeling recoil, subtle delayed hair/cape response, no lower-body translation.
07 recovered kneeling aim, return toward 00 without any standing up, knee lift or ground sliding.

reload.title: 장전
keys: 00 start fully shouldered: same baseline guard stance, right firing hand on grip, left support hand under handguard, existing magazine installed.
02 remove old magazine: right hand keeps grip/control and stock at shoulder, left hand has pulled the old magazine down and away from the magwell, clearly separate; rifle still points screen-right.
04 insert new magazine: left hand guides a replacement magazine upward into the magwell, old magazine no longer floats in scene, right hand still on grip, feet/pelvis/head unchanged.
06 finish manipulation: new magazine seated, left hand briefly reaches receiver/bolt release then starts returning toward handguard; no extra arms or floating second gun.
between: 01 support hand leaves handguard and reaches the magazine/magwell to release the old magazine. Right hand keeps firearm supported.
03 left hand takes replacement magazine near the waist pouch while right hand supports rifle; one magazine in the hand, no floating old magazine.
05 left hand firmly seats new magazine upward; receiver/bolt release manipulation beginning, fingers wrapped around magazine.
07 END: left hand returns to handguard, both hands resume original aimed grip, magazine installed and rifle shouldered. Hold this final pose; no automatic reload loop.
